item.tib: phur bu rtse med gsang ba'i gzhung chen
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni dbal bon gyis phung bon la phyi rabs donadu brgyud)cing snying (nying) khu dmar du mdzad/ de nas dun tse'i ma rigs (rig) 'phrag dog gis bon rnams res shig nubs(nub/)de dus gsang ba'i bon 'di dag stag la nyid kyis 'byed du bcug cing thugs la sbas/ ma 'ongs dar ba'i smon lam btabs(btab/)de nas da lta gnyis kyis (kyi) bar/ mi lo lnga brgya dang bdun bcu'i bar du sbas nas/ kho bo dbra rigs g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag gis me rta zla tshes la gyim shod ri bo'i nub phyogs mdun zhol/ zor dor gnyen po g.yu rtse zhes pa dbal ri zur gsum dung mdog 'dra ba/ ri rin po che'i bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsi bcud kyis bkang pa 'dra ba/ nag ze rin chen 'bar ba'i skad (rked) pa g.yung drung gling dgon zhes pa/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i yang zab bon mchog khro 'o (bo) gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi sgrab gnas/ sa gzhi rin chen g.yu yi gzhong pa gang pa 'dra ba/ bdal pas (pa'i) gshin chen zhes bya ba ru/ sngon gyis (gyi) skye ba snga mas (ma'i) las 'phro cung tsam sad par byas nas bgyis shing*/ shugs dgon phun 'tshogs (tshogs) gling nas dbal gshen stag la bsgrubs pa'i bon gshen las ldan gnyis kyis/ sam b+hu tra la dag par bshus so//
